failure_reason: POLICY BLOCK: robots.txt at https://www.home24.de/robots.txt explicitly disallows ClaudeBot site-wide ('User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /'), separate from and more restrictive than the generic '*' group (which only blocks a handful of account/checkout paths). Fresh re-check on 2026-09-09 via curl_cffi chrome131-impersonated GET (HTTP 200) returned byte-identical robots.txt content to the 2026-08-11 check recorded in notes/281.md, which itself matched the identical block found for the same domain at S.N. 113 'Home24 DE' and S.N. 159. A direct/unimpersonated fetch (with or without a browser User-Agent) returns HTTP 403 with a WAF 'Sorry, your request has been blocked' page. Per this project's consistent stance (applied to this exact domain twice before), a targeted Claude-specific full-site disallow is treated as a deliberate opt-out of Claude/Anthropic access, not a generic anti-bot wall to route around. No bypass or extraction was attempted beyond the robots.txt policy-confirmation fetch itself.
notes: This is the third SR in this project to hit the identical home24.de ClaudeBot block (after S.N. 113 and S.N. 159, per notes/281.md). Only action taken: (1) direct fetch of https://www.home24.de/robots.txt -> HTTP 403 WAF block page; (2) curl_cffi chrome131-impersonated fetch of the same robots.txt -> HTTP 200, content unchanged, ClaudeBot disallow confirmed still present. No navigation discovery, no Bestsellers PLP candidates were opened, and no site content beyond robots.txt was fetched, consistent with the policy-block handling used for the prior two SRs on this domain.
